title: Spaghetti & Meatballs
description: Tender meatballs simmered in a simple tomato sauce.
imageAlt: Spaghetti and meatballs in tomato sauce

items: ½ cup grated Parmesan, plus more to serve

steps.title: Soak the crumbs
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a rimmed baking sheet. Stir ¾ cup breadcrumbs and ⅓ cup milk together and leave 5 minutes.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Mix the soaked breadcrumbs with 1 pound ground beef, ½ pound ground pork, ½ cup Parmesan, 1 egg, 2 minced garlic cloves, 2 tablespoons chopped parsley, and 1½ teaspoons kosher salt just until combined. Roll into 18 balls and set on the lined sheet.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Bake the meatballs at 425°F until browned, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Warm the oil and 3 sliced garlic cloves in a wide pot over medium-low until fragrant. Add both 28-ounce cans of crushed tomatoes, 1 basil sprig, and 1 teaspoon kosher salt and simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer together
steps.text: Add the meatballs and simmer gently for 20 minutes, until they reach 160°F.

steps.title: Boil and toss
steps.text: Cook the 1 pound spaghetti in a large pot of salted water until al dente, following the package timing. Drain and toss with some sauce. Top with the meatballs, more sauce, and extra Parmesan.
